list_contacts.title: List contacts
list_contacts.description: List all contacts in the CallHub account with phone, mobile, name, email, address and phonebook URLs. Use list_phonebook_contacts for one phonebook.

output.description: Paginated DRF envelope: count, next, previous and `results`.

create_contact.title: Create a contact
create_contact.description: Create a contact. `contact` (phone number, used by voice campaigns) is required; mobile is used by text campaigns. Use upsert_phonebook_contact to create and add to a phonebook in one call.

contact.description: Phone number for voice campaigns, e.g. 15019028176.

mobile.description: Mobile number, used for text campaigns.

country_code.description: 2-letter ISO country code used to prefix numbers, e.g. US.

update_contact.title: Update a contact
update_contact.description: Change a contact's details. `contact` (phone number) must be supplied even when unchanged.

mobile.description: Mobile number, used for text campaigns.

country_code.description: 2-letter ISO country code used to prefix numbers, e.g. US.

delete_contact.title: Delete a contact
delete_contact.description: Permanently delete a contact from the account and all phonebooks.

list_contact_fields.title: List contact fields
list_contact_fields.description: List all contact fields (built-in and custom) with their id and name; ids are used in bulk_create_contacts mappings.

bulk_create_contacts.title: Bulk import contacts from CSV
bulk_create_contacts.description: Import contacts from a hosted CSV file into a phonebook. Rate-limited to 1 call per minute; imports run one at a time. mapping is JSON mapping CallHub field id to CSV column index, e.g. {"0":"2"} (CONTACT=0, MOBILE=1, LAST_NAME=2, FIRST_NAME=3, EMAIL=4, COUNTRY_CODE=5, ADDRESS=6, CITY=7, STATE=8, ZIPCODE=9, JOB_TITLE=10, COMPANY_NAME=11, COMPANY_WEBSITE=12, NAME=13, ADDITIONAL_VARS=14, TAGS=16).
bulk_create_contacts.notes: Direct file upload (contacts_csv) is not supported by this tool; host the CSV and pass csv_url.

phonebook_id.description: Phonebook to add the imported contacts to.

csv_url.description: Public URL (e.g. Google Drive) of the CSV file.

mapping.description: JSON string mapping field id to CSV column index, e.g. {"0":"0","3":"1"}.

country_choice.description: Where contact countries come from: file (a mapped column) or custom (country_iso).

country_iso.description: Country code applied to all contacts when country_choice is custom.

output.description: Import job details, or throttling information if called too soon.

add_contact_tags.title: Add tags to a contact
add_contact_tags.description: Add one or more tags (by name) to a contact; tags that don't exist are created. Use remove_contact_tag to detach one.

remove_contact_tag.title: Remove a tag from a contact
remove_contact_tag.description: Detach a tag from a contact. The tag itself remains in the account.

list_phonebooks.title: List phonebooks
list_phonebooks.description: List phonebooks (contact lists) with url, owner, name and description. Campaigns dial or text the contacts in their phonebooks.

output.description: Paginated DRF envelope: count, next, previous and `results`.

create_phonebook.title: Create a phonebook
create_phonebook.description: Create an empty phonebook; add contacts with add_contacts_to_phonebook, upsert_phonebook_contact or bulk_create_contacts.

update_phonebook.title: Update a phonebook
update_phonebook.description: Rename a phonebook or change its description.

delete_phonebook.title: Delete a phonebook
delete_phonebook.description: Delete a phonebook. Campaigns using it lose those contacts.

list_phonebook_contacts.title: List contacts in a phonebook
list_phonebook_contacts.description: List every contact in one phonebook with full contact details.

output.description: Paginated DRF envelope: count, next, previous and `results`.

add_contacts_to_phonebook.title: Add contacts to a phonebook
add_contacts_to_phonebook.description: Add existing contacts (by id) to a phonebook.

remove_contacts_from_phonebook.title: Remove contacts from a phonebook
remove_contacts_from_phonebook.description: Remove contacts (by id) from a phonebook; the contacts themselves are kept.

get_phonebook_numbers_count.title: Count numbers in a phonebook
get_phonebook_numbers_count.description: Get how many phone numbers and mobile numbers a phonebook holds, e.g. before launching a campaign.

output.description: Counts of phone and mobile numbers.

upsert_phonebook_contact.title: Upsert a contact into a phonebook
upsert_phonebook_contact.description: Create a contact in a phonebook, or add the existing contact with that number to it. Numbers are validated against country_code (or the account country); use E.164 for international numbers.

mobile.description: Mobile number, used for text campaigns.

country_code.description: 2-letter ISO country code used to prefix numbers, e.g. US.

create_tag.title: Create a tag
create_tag.description: Create a tag in CallHub for labelling contacts and filtering campaigns.

get_tag.title: Get a tag
get_tag.description: Retrieve one tag's details (id, name) by its id; create tags with create_tag.

list_custom_fields.title: List custom fields
list_custom_fields.description: List custom contact fields with id, name, field_type, multi-choice options and dates.

create_custom_field.title: Create a custom field
create_custom_field.description: Create a custom contact field of type Text, Number, Boolean or Multi-choice (with choices).

rename_custom_field.title: Rename a custom field
rename_custom_field.description: Rename a custom field; the new name must not match an existing custom field.

delete_custom_field.title: Delete a custom field
delete_custom_field.description: Delete a custom field and its values on all contacts.

list_dnc_lists.title: List DNC lists
list_dnc_lists.description: List Do-Not-Call lists (url, owner, name). Numbers on these lists are skipped by campaigns.

output.description: Paginated DRF envelope: count, next, previous and `results`.

create_dnc_list.title: Create a DNC list
create_dnc_list.description: Create a Do-Not-Call list; add numbers to it with create_dnc_contact.

update_dnc_list.title: Rename a DNC list
update_dnc_list.description: Rename a Do-Not-Call list; its numbers are unchanged.

delete_dnc_list.title: Delete a DNC list
delete_dnc_list.description: Delete a Do-Not-Call list; its numbers can be contacted again.

list_dnc_contacts.title: List DNC contacts
list_dnc_contacts.description: List numbers on Do-Not-Call lists with the list each belongs to.

output.description: Paginated DRF envelope: count, next, previous and `results`.

create_dnc_contact.title: Add a number to a DNC list
create_dnc_contact.description: Add a phone number to a Do-Not-Call list so campaigns stop calling and/or texting it.

dnc.description: URL of the DNC list, e.g. https://api.callhub.io/v1/dnc_lists/5769/.

category.description: 1 = opted out of calling only, 2 = texting only, 3 = both.

update_dnc_contact.title: Update a DNC contact
update_dnc_contact.description: Change the number or list of a Do-Not-Call entry.

delete_dnc_contact.title: Remove a number from DNC
delete_dnc_contact.description: Remove a number from its Do-Not-Call list so campaigns may contact it again.

list_webhooks.title: List webhooks
list_webhooks.description: List registered webhooks with id, event and target URL.

output.description: Paginated DRF envelope: count, next, previous and `results`.

create_webhook.title: Create a webhook
create_webhook.description: Register a URL to be called on a CallHub event: vb.transfer (transfer digit pressed in a voice broadcast), sb.reply (text reply received), cc.notes (call center agent added notes) or agent.activation.

target.description: URL to call when the event fires.

delete_webhook.title: Delete a webhook
delete_webhook.description: Delete a webhook so its target stops receiving events.

get_account.title: Get account details
get_account.description: Return the CallHub user for this API key with related objects: business phones, phonebooks and voice, SMS and call center campaign URLs.

output.description: User object(s) with related resource URLs.

get_credits_usage.title: Get credits usage
get_credits_usage.description: Return credit usage for a date range (UTC days), optionally for one campaign type (1 SMS Broadcast, 3 Text2Join, 4 P2P, 5 Call Centre, 6 Voice Broadcast). Without end_date, covers one day.

share_credits.title: Share credits with a subaccount
share_credits.description: Transfer account credit (in dollars) from an enterprise account to one of its subaccounts. Moves money; not reversible by this API.

list_agents.title: List agents
list_agents.description: List verified agents in the account (id, username, email, owner, teams).

output.description: Paginated DRF envelope: count, next, previous and `results`.

get_agent.title: Get an agent
get_agent.description: Retrieve one agent's id, username, email and owner.

create_agent.title: Create an agent
create_agent.description: Invite a new agent: CallHub emails a verification link and the agent becomes usable once verified.

email.description: Email the invite is sent to.

team.description: Name of the team to put the agent in.

delete_agent.title: Delete an agent
delete_agent.description: Delete an agent from the account; they can no longer log in or make calls.

list_live_agents.title: List agents connected to campaigns
list_live_agents.description: List agents currently connected (live) to any campaign, for monitoring.

list_teams.title: List teams
list_teams.description: List agent teams in the account with their ids and names.

output.description: Paginated DRF envelope: count, next, previous and `results`.

create_team.title: Create a team
create_team.description: Create an agent team; add agents with add_agents_to_team.

get_team.title: Get a team
get_team.description: Retrieve one agent team by id, including its name and agents.

rename_team.title: Rename a team
rename_team.description: Change an agent team's name; membership is unchanged.

delete_team.title: Delete a team
delete_team.description: Delete an agent team (agents remain in the account).

list_team_agents.title: List a team's agents
list_team_agents.description: List the agents assigned to a team. Use get_team_agent_details for fuller agent records.

get_team_agent_details.title: Get team agent details
get_team_agent_details.description: Get detailed records for every agent in a team.

add_agents_to_team.title: Add agents to a team
add_agents_to_team.description: Assign existing agents (by id) to a team.

remove_agents_from_team.title: Remove agents from a team
remove_agents_from_team.description: Remove agents (by id) from a team; they stay in the account.

list_callcenter_campaigns.title: List call center campaigns
list_callcenter_campaigns.description: List call center (power/predictive dialer) campaigns with name, status (1 start, 2 pause, 3 abort, 4 end) and phonebooks.

output.description: Paginated DRF envelope: count, next, previous and `results`.

get_callcenter_campaign.title: Get a call center campaign
get_callcenter_campaign.description: Retrieve one call center campaign including status, phonebooks, dispositions and retry settings (maxretry, intervalretry, retry_dispositions).

update_callcenter_campaign.title: Start, pause, end or rename a call center campaign
update_callcenter_campaign.description: Rename a call center campaign or change its status (start, pause, end). Starting begins dialing contacts; ending is permanent.

status.description: New status: 1 = START, 2 = PAUSE, 4 = END (permanent). START fails if the campaign has no contacts, no caller ID or is pending approval.

delete_callcenter_campaign.title: Delete a call center campaign
delete_callcenter_campaign.description: Permanently delete a call center campaign.

create_callcenter_campaign.title: Create a call center campaign
create_callcenter_campaign.description: Create a call center (power dialer) campaign over phonebooks with caller ID, schedule, script (or template_id), dispositions, retries and agent assignment.

script.description: Script sections in order: {type: 12 paragraph | 1 multi choice | 3 numeric, script_text (type 12), question, choices: [{answer}], name}.

use_contact_timezone.description: Call US contacts in their own time zone.

block_cellphone.description: Skip cellphone numbers (use when you lack opt-ins).

notes_required.description: Force agents to add notes for every call.

agent_assignment_choice.description: 1 = assign team(s), 2 = all agents, 3 = selected agents.

call_dispositions.description: Case-sensitive dispositions available to agents, e.g. ANSWER.

create_missing_dispositions.description: Create dispositions that don't exist yet.

template_id.description: Saved script template to use instead of script.

retry_dispositions.description: Dispositions that trigger a retry (subset of call_dispositions, e.g. NO_ANSWER, USER_BUSY, MACHINE). Requires maxretry >= 1.

list_callcenter_rented_numbers.title: List rented numbers for call center
list_callcenter_rented_numbers.description: List rented numbers available as caller IDs for call center campaigns.

export_callcenter_campaign.title: Export call center campaign results
export_callcenter_campaign.description: Queue an export of a call center campaign's results for a date range. Poll get_export_job with the returned job id until status is SUCCESS to get the CSV download URL.

output.description: Export job with its polling URL.

get_export_job.title: Get an export job
get_export_job.description: Poll a campaign export job; when status is SUCCESS the response includes the CSV download URL.

output.description: Job status and, when finished, the download URL.

assign_callcenter_agents.title: Assign agents to a call center campaign
assign_callcenter_agents.description: Assign agents and/or teams to a call center campaign, or all agents with assign_all.

list_callcenter_campaign_agents.title: List a call center campaign's agents
list_callcenter_campaign_agents.description: List the agents assigned to a call center campaign.

list_voice_broadcasts.title: List voice broadcast campaigns
list_voice_broadcasts.description: List voice broadcast (robocall) campaigns with name, calls-per-minute frequency, status and phonebooks.

output.description: Paginated DRF envelope: count, next, previous and `results`.

update_voice_broadcast.title: Start, pause, end or rename a voice broadcast
update_voice_broadcast.description: Rename a voice broadcast, change its call rate, or start/pause/end it. Starting places calls to every contact.

status.description: New status: 1 = START, 2 = PAUSE, 4 = END (permanent). START fails if the campaign has no contacts, no caller ID or is pending approval.

delete_voice_broadcast.title: Delete a voice broadcast
delete_voice_broadcast.description: Permanently delete a voice broadcast campaign.

create_voice_broadcast.title: Create a voice broadcast
create_voice_broadcast.description: Create a voice broadcast campaign over phonebooks with a live message (script) or a vb template, caller ID options, schedule, contact filters and answering-machine settings.

script.description: {"live_message": {"question": "Text played on pickup"}}. Use this or template_id.

amd_options.description: Answering machine detection: {voicemail (bool), amd_behavior (int), voicemail_audiofile (media file id)}.

duplicate_voice_broadcast.title: Duplicate a voice broadcast
duplicate_voice_broadcast.description: Copy an existing voice broadcast campaign onto new phonebooks, optionally with a new name and caller ID, or into another account (multi-org).

list_vb_templates.title: List voice broadcast templates
list_vb_templates.description: List voice broadcast templates (live message, transfer and DNC key options) usable via template_id.

create_vb_template.title: Create a voice broadcast template
create_vb_template.description: Create a voice broadcast template: the live message, keypress transfers (number, record, transcript, hangup) and a DNC opt-out key.

live_message.description: {question: text to play, audiofile: media file id}.

list_sms_campaigns.title: List SMS campaigns
list_sms_campaigns.description: List SMS (text broadcast) campaigns with name, status and phonebooks.

output.description: Paginated DRF envelope: count, next, previous and `results`.

update_sms_campaign.title: Start, pause, end or rename an SMS campaign
update_sms_campaign.description: Rename an SMS campaign or start/pause/end it. Starting sends texts to every contact.

status.description: New status: 1 = START, 2 = PAUSE, 4 = END (permanent). START fails if the campaign has no contacts, no caller ID or is pending approval.

delete_sms_campaign.title: Delete an SMS campaign
delete_sms_campaign.description: Permanently delete an SMS campaign and its settings.

export_sms_report.title: Export SMS report
export_sms_report.description: Query the SMS message report across campaigns: filter by date, status, error code, campaign, direction and message type, with offset/limit paging.

error_code.description: Error code filter (0 = no errors, -1 = all).

output.description: SMS report rows or export details.

create_sms_broadcast.title: Create a text broadcast
create_sms_broadcast.description: Create an SMS/MMS text broadcast campaign to phonebooks with message, caller ID choice, keyword auto-replies, schedule and compliance settings.

callerid.description: Caller ID in E.164 (required when callerid_choice is exists).

auto_replies.description: Keyword auto-replies [{keyword, trigger_message, media_files, base_short_url}]; pass [] for none.

timezone_choices.description: Time zone, e.g. America/Chicago (defaults to profile).

help_compliance_message.description: Compliance text, e.g. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.

output.description: {id, name, status, url} of the created campaign.

duplicate_sms_broadcast.title: Duplicate a text broadcast
duplicate_sms_broadcast.description: Copy an existing text broadcast onto new phonebooks with a new caller ID and optional name.

create_p2p_campaign.title: Create a P2P texting campaign
create_p2p_campaign.description: Create a peer-to-peer texting campaign: phonebooks, caller IDs, script (or template_id), schedule, contact options, agent settings and saved replies.

script.description: {questions: [{question, type: "12" text | "1" multi choice}]}. Use this or template_id.

contact_options.description: {use_contact_tz, dont_text_litigator, tags, dont_text_dnc, sort_order (1|2), auto_send, opt_out_language}.

agent_settings.description: {agents, review_agents, notes_required, agent_reminder, moderation_enabled, thankyou_message, agent_brief, agent_choice: later|available|team|assign_all}.

update_p2p_campaign_status.title: Start, pause, end or rename a P2P campaign
update_p2p_campaign_status.description: Change a P2P campaign's status (1 start, 2 pause, 4 end) and/or name. A running campaign can only be renamed in the same request that pauses or ends it.

status.description: New status: 1 = START, 2 = PAUSE, 4 = END (permanent). START fails if the campaign has no contacts, no caller ID or is pending approval.

duplicate_p2p_campaign.title: Duplicate a P2P campaign
duplicate_p2p_campaign.description: Copy a P2P campaign onto new phonebooks with a caller ID and optional new name.
duplicate_p2p_campaign.notes: The reference lists the path as /v1/p2p_campaigns/{campaign_id}/duplicate// (double slash); this tool uses a single trailing slash.

edit_p2p_campaign.title: Edit a P2P campaign
edit_p2p_campaign.description: Edit a P2P campaign's settings: name, caller ID, phonebooks, agent brief, running days, hours, dates, agent and contact assignment, auto-send and recommended replies.

callerid.description: Caller ID to send and receive messages.

add_p2p_survey_question.title: Add a survey question to a P2P campaign
add_p2p_survey_question.description: Add a script section to a P2P campaign: text (type 2), number (type 3) or multi-choice (type 1) survey question, optionally as the initial message.

add_p2p_nationbuilder_event.title: Add a NationBuilder event to a P2P campaign
add_p2p_nationbuilder_event.description: Attach a NationBuilder event to a P2P campaign script, optionally as the initial message.

is_initial_message.description: Set to make this the initial message.

add_p2p_supporter_levels.title: Add NationBuilder supporter levels to a P2P campaign
add_p2p_supporter_levels.description: Add a NationBuilder supporter-level section to a P2P campaign script.

add_p2p_nationbuilder_survey.title: Add a NationBuilder survey to a P2P campaign
add_p2p_nationbuilder_survey.description: Attach a NationBuilder survey to a P2P (collective texting) campaign.

assign_p2p_agents.title: Assign agents to a P2P campaign
assign_p2p_agents.description: Assign agents to a P2P campaign, optionally with a contact count per agent group.

get_p2p_api_schema.title: Get P2P campaign API schema
get_p2p_api_schema.description: Return the schema of options accepted when creating P2P campaigns via the API.

list_templates.title: List script templates
list_templates.description: List campaign script templates (labels and questions) usable as template_id in call center and P2P campaigns.

create_template.title: Create a script template
create_template.description: Create a reusable campaign script template from questions/text blocks (type "12" text, "1" multiple choice).

questions.description: [{type: "12"|"1", question, question_name, choices: [{answer, display_number}], media_files, is_initial_message, question_id, integration_custom_fields, base_short_url}].

get_templates_api_schema.title: Get template API schema
get_templates_api_schema.description: Return the supported question types and fields for create_template.

list_questions.title: List integration survey questions
list_questions.description: List survey questions from connected integrations (VAN / PDI) whose ids can be used as question_id in templates.

list_media.title: List media files
list_media.description: List media library files (audio, images, video) whose ids are used in templates, saved replies and MMS.

list_shortened_urls.title: List shortened URLs
list_shortened_urls.description: List URL shortener configurations whose ids are used as base_short_url in messages.

list_integration_fields.title: List integration fields
list_integration_fields.description: List CRM integration custom fields (e.g. Salesforce) that template answers can be saved to.

get_integration_fields_schema.title: Get integration fields schema
get_integration_fields_schema.description: Return the API schema describing integration fields.

create_relational_campaign.title: Create a relational organizing campaign
create_relational_campaign.description: Create a relational organizing campaign where agents reach their own contacts by call or share, with scripts, survey, schedule and agent assignment.

banner_id.description: Media file ID for the banner.

get_relational_campaign.title: Get a relational organizing campaign
get_relational_campaign.description: Retrieve one relational organizing campaign's configuration.

edit_relational_campaign.title: Edit a relational organizing campaign
edit_relational_campaign.description: Replace a relational organizing campaign's configuration (all required fields must be resent), adding or deleting survey sections and options.

banner_id.description: Media file ID for the banner.

new_survey_scripts.description: New survey questions (same shape as survey_scripts).

update_relational_campaign_status.title: Change a relational campaign's status
update_relational_campaign_status.description: Start (1), pause (2) or stop (3) a relational organizing campaign.

duplicate_relational_campaign.title: Duplicate a relational campaign
duplicate_relational_campaign.description: Copy a relational organizing campaign under a new name onto new contact lists.

update_relational_campaign_agents.title: Assign or remove relational campaign agents
update_relational_campaign_agents.description: Assign agents to and/or remove agents from a relational organizing campaign.

list_rented_calling_numbers.title: List rented calling numbers
list_rented_calling_numbers.description: List phone numbers rented for calling, filterable by country, region and prefix, sortable by last rent/use date.

target_account.description: Username of a target (sub)account to act on, sent as X-Target-Account.

countries.description: Comma-separated country ISO codes, e.g. CA,US.

include_running_campaign_numbers.description: 1 to include numbers used by running campaigns.

list_validated_numbers.title: List validated numbers
list_validated_numbers.description: List your own phone numbers validated for use as caller IDs.

target_account.description: Username of a target (sub)account to act on, sent as X-Target-Account.

rent_number.title: Rent a phone number
rent_number.description: Rent a new calling number in a country (optionally an area code; falls back to any number in the country). Incurs charges.

target_account.description: Username of a target (sub)account to act on, sent as X-Target-Account.

campaign_type.description: Campaign type the number is for.
